Remark
[curvature, Einstein condition, and Weyl tensor of a product]

Source: petersen:page-0172, petersen:page-0173 1. ch4:4.7.9Let $(M,g)=(M_1\times M_2,g_1+g_2)$. (1) Show $R=R_1+R_2$ (pulled back). (2) Assume $(M_i,g_i)$ has constant curvature $c_i$; show $R=c_1g_1\circ g_1+c_2g_2\circ g_2$. (3) Show $(M,g)$ is Einstein iff $(n_1-1)c_1=(n_2-1)c_2$, $n_i=\dim M_i$. (4) Show the Weyl tensor vanishes if $c_1=-c_2$, $n_1=1$, or $n_2=1$. (5) Show the Weyl tensor does not vanish if none of these hold.
